standard_prerequisites.name: Fibred over fibred
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that Y is a fibred category over C, settling stack condition (1).

standard_prerequisites.name: Stack and descent data definitions
standard_prerequisites.use: Fix the three stack conditions and the shape of the descent data used in condition (3).

core_obligations: Condition (1): fibredness over C from the fibred-over-fibred lemma.

Condition (2): given local morphisms y_1|_{U_i} -> y_2 agreeing on overlaps, descend q of them to psi : x_1 -> x_2 using that X is a stack; lift psi to a strongly cartesian y_{12} -> y_2 over it; the local morphisms become sections of the Y-fibre Mor presheaf over the covering {x_1|_{U_i} -> x_1}, which glues by the stack property of Y over X.

Condition (3): transfer the descent datum (y_i, varphi_{ij}) to (x_i, psi_{ij}) in X, effectuate it there, and read the same datum as a descent datum relative to the covering {x|_{U_i} -> x} of the single object x, which is effective because Y is a stack over X.
Groupoid assertion: Y is fibred in groupoids over X hence over C, so the stack in groupoids conclusion follows.
proof_roadmap: Check the three stack conditions in order, threading the descent problem through the stack property of X and then the stack property of Y over X.
difficulty_reason: The glueing and descent steps each route through two stacked stack structures, with a strongly cartesian lift doing the transfer between the levels.
